name: Peugeot
description: Peugeot / PSA (also Citroen, DS) over a generic OBD-II dongle. UDS on the diagnostic CAN bus for AEE2010-era cars (~2010+). Each module has its own PSA-specific CAN id pair (BSI 752/652, engine 6A8/688, airbag 744/644, ...), not the standard request+8. Pre-2004 VAN-bus cars are unreachable by any ELM327; 2004-2010 KWP2000 cars are out of scope.

panel.title: All modules (OBD dongle)
panel.hint: Module scan for Peugeot / PSA cars (~2010+, also Citroën and DS) over the ordinary OBD dongle — each module answers on its own PSA CAN id pair (BSI, engine, ABS, airbag, cluster…), and every module's VIN is cross-checked. Pick the adapter top-right, ignition ON, then scan. Pre-2004 (VAN) and many 2004–2010 (KWP) cars can't be reached over a plain dongle.
panel.scanBusy: Walking the PSA modules by their own CAN ids… (absent modules time out quietly)

actions.label: Health check
actions.title: Peugeot health check
actions.hint: DPF soot/regen data on HDi diesels, EV battery State-of-Health on e-CMP cars, plus odometer readings from several modules cross-checked — a mismatch is a clocking red flag.
